title: Messages reach the session that owns the task, and Tally sends TJ one combined update

requirements.text: genlock tell accepts a task id or short name and delivers to the session that owns that task
requirements.check: tests/run.mjs: genlock tell T-XXXX 'hi' writes the tell file into that task's session channel, not the main session's

requirements.text: genlock tell PROJECT with several open sessions and no --session refuses and lists each session by its task, instead of silently picking one
requirements.check: tests/run.mjs: project with 2 sessions, tell without --session exits non-zero and names both

requirements.text: The Assistant's rule says: route by task, wait for replies, and give the user one combined update rather than one per reply or idle notice
requirements.check: app/Tests: SessionLaunch.arguments for the assistant contains the combine-replies rule

text: From TJ via Tally: 'a really terrible update'. tell PROJECT went to the main session (lib/overview.mjs:288 picks the first non-spawn session); go-ahead for T-2AAH6 sat idle 08:45-11:50; Tally then broadcast + relayed ~5 near-identical updates. --session matches spawn.ticket id only (sessionName L305), not short names. Starts after T-2AAH6, which holds lib/overview.mjs.

evidence: tests/run.mjs pass: 'tell TASK reaches the session that owns it, not another' (tok-a=1, tok-s=0, tok-x=0), '...by its short name too', '--session takes a task short name', 'tell TASK with no session working on it refuses and says how to open one'

tests/run.mjs pass: 'tell PROJECT with several sessions refuses' (no tell file written in any of 3 channels) and '...and lists each session by its task' ([main] on <short> (Proved but open task), [T-..], [+abc123], no task recorded)

app swift test: testAssistantRoutesByTaskAndCombinesReplies passes (assistant args contain 'genlock tell TASK' and 'give the user one update covering all of them'; project args lack it); 121 tests, 0 failures

answers.observed: node tests/run.mjs 484 passed 0 failed (7 new tell checks); swift test 121 tests 0 failures
answers.cause: measured: tell files counted per channel folder after each tell
answers.absence: suite prints only failures, so a pass is the absence of a failure line plus the 484 total going up from 472
answers.assumption: a session owns a task by conversation id (state.json session) or spawn.ticket, same rule overview uses
answers.falsify: a live project where the owning session's state.json lacks its conversation id would refuse tell TASK

text: Built: tell takes TASK (id or short) and routes to the owning session; tell PROJECT with several sessions refuses and lists them by task; --session and close accept a task short name. Assistant rule: route by task, one combined update. Tests pass. Not committed; app needs relaunch for the new rule.
